author: Inside Edition
description: Authorities in Florida say this wasn't just a house fire, they say it was an attempted murder. Port St. Lucie Police responded to the call and learned someone was still in the house. Several officers braved the smoke and flames to go find her. They say they found a 62-year-old woman hiding in a bathroom and when she got out, she had a terrifying account for investigators. She claimed the suspect set fire to a bedroom. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Police Rescue Woman Who Locked Herself In Bathroom During Alleged Arson

author: Inside Edition
description: One minute it was hailing and the next this woman's car was floating away. Police in Aurora, Colorado, say a flash flood left her stranded at a gas station. They waded into the water to give her a hand out of the vehicle before it floated off anywhere else. Not only was the woman carried to dry land, she was also given a ride home. Police used the video to remind people how unpredictable weather can be. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Police Carry Woman From Car After She Got Caught In Flash Flood
